title: Correctness: FIPS gate not first in write() and read() OPERATION paths
description: In crypto2dev_fd_write() (line 354), the ops->fips_gate() call is at line 409, after: (1) count==0 early return (362), (2) count>MAX_PAYLOAD check (365), (3) kmalloc+copy_from_user (369-376), (4) fd_type checks (380-401), (5) finalized check (393), (6) error check (398), (7) IV enforcement check (404). In crypto2dev_fd_read() OPERATION path, fips_gate() is at line 573, after error check (568). CLAUDE.md states the gate must be the first executable statement before argument validation and before anything else. The finalized, error, and iv_set checks at lines 393-407 in write() run before the FIPS gate — if FIPS is not operational, these branches execute before the gate fires, and in the iv_set case, write() returns -EINVAL (not -EACCES) masking the actual FIPS failure mode from the caller.
close_reason: FIPS gate moved to immediately after mutex_lock() in ioctl_finalize, ioctl_reset, write(), read(), ioctl_set_iv, ioctl_gen_iv, ioctl_set_aad, ioctl_set_tag, ioctl_get_tag — using state->ops null-guard
